ex.q: Where do we stand out against rivals?
ex.a:
From the Fora website: Speakeasy style lounge, Sky Lounge with mountain views, free covered parking, resort style pool, premium gym with spin and yoga, coworking studios, resident media room, BBQ stations and firepit lounge, dog park and pet spa, four EV chargers, smart home with keyless entry, full size washer and gas dryer, 9 foot ceilings, walk in closets.
  • Google rating: 4.5 on 135 reviews, above The Pearl at St. Rose and Positano.
  • Bigger homes: our 1 bed is 805 sq ft and our B1 2 bed is 1,150 sq ft, against 708 and 965 at The Pearl and 751 and 995 at Positano.
  • Free covered parking. Marlowe lists covered parking at $25 a month.
  • Pets: $50 a month and a $500 pet fee, no weight limits, up to 3 pets.

ex.q: Who showed the tour? Pending service requests?
ex.a: Tour agents and service requests live in your property management system, which is not connected to this app. Tours you log in Tour mode are on your desk list.

We cannot see each person’s reason, but here is what they see when they compare you:
  • The Pearl and Marlowe list lower starting base rents; Positano is lower on 2 beds only. 1 bedroom from: The Pearl $1,299, Fora $1,568, Positano $1,580.
  • The Pearl runs a similar no rent until 2027 offer, and Positano posts six weeks free on select 2 bedrooms.
